pwsbuilder March 13, 2021

Chatham Bars Inn Winter ‘Meet the Artists’ Art Series will host the Guild of Harwich Artists on Saturday, March 20, from 1:00 – 5:00 p.m. The lobby exhibition will feature seventeen artists whose paintings were curated by Domonic Boreffi of the Gallery Antonia, Chatham.

Attendees will be welcome to view and purchase the art on display, and speak with the artists to gain further insight into the paintings or works of art. Each 30-minute session will host twenty attendees and all sessions are complimentary and open to the public. Advance registration is encouraged by contacting the CBI concierge at (508) 945-6871.
